space: normalized (train-standardized) units; author reduction = mean over windows x steps x channels

estimators_and_limitations.global/per_step/per_channel errors: exact float64 sums over the full population; MAPE/MSPE exclude |true| <= 1e-8 (population reported)
estimators_and_limitations.naive: persistence = last input value repeated; seasonal24 = the input value 24 h before each step (wraps within the 96-step window for steps > 24: an approximation past step 24)
estimators_and_limitations.residual moments: exact float64 power sums (mean, var, skew, kurtosis); kurtosis is raw (not excess)
estimators_and_limitations.quantiles: APPROXIMATE: read from a 2000-bin histogram on [-20, 20] (bin width 0.02); residuals outside the range are not binned (counts sum vs population reported); not a full exact distribution
estimators_and_limitations.entropy: of the same clipped 2000-bin histogram, bits; depends on the bin width
estimators_and_limitations.mutual_information: APPROXIMATE: 64 x 64 joint histogram of clipped values on [-6, 6]; plug-in estimator, biased upward for small populations
estimators_and_limitations.autocorrelation: sample ACF along consecutive test windows (one hour apart) of the CHANNEL-MEAN residual per step (lags 1..max_lag) and of each channel's residual at the first and last steps (lags 1, 24, 168); no PACF, no spectral estimate; no confidence bands (the windows overlap by construction, so the usual 1/sqrt(W) band does not apply)
estimators_and_limitations.r2/corr: per channel and global, exact sums; None when the true variance is zero
estimators_and_limitations.uncertainty: none per estimator: one cell is one sample; seed dispersion is reported at the table level
estimators_and_limitations.independent_check: global MSE/MAE equal the author's metric() within 1e-6 and the float64 reduction (closure); per-step and per-channel means average back to the global values (tests)

autocorrelation.reading: residual autocorrelation along consecutive test windows (one hour apart)
